ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (30) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The episode is from Dostoevsky's «Записки из Мертвого дома» (Zapiski iz Myortvogo doma), given under its usual English title 'Notes from the House of the Dead'; the eagle is 'he' throughout, as «он» in the source. The convicts' «воля» (volya, with the folk diminutive «волюшка», volyushka) is 'liberty', kept apart from «свобода» / folk «слобода» (svoboda / sloboda), 'freedom'; the idiom «чёрта в чемодане не строй» (chorta v chemodane ne stroy, literally 'don't build him a devil in a suitcase') is kept literal.
